provenance.writtenFor: DROBON AEGIS DAST original intelligence expansion master pump (2026-10-19)
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A SameSite=None cookie without Secure is refused by browsers, so no stored cookie exists and the flag rules must stay silent; DPK-DAST-071 owns the defect.

groundTruth.rationale: RFC 6265bis-style browser behaviour rejects SameSite=None unless Secure is present. Nothing is stored, so there is no cookie that can lack Secure, HttpOnly or SameSite; reporting those would describe a cookie the user agent discarded.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live request.
The refused cookie is still a defect; it is reported by DPK-DAST-071.
